verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents screening customers against a global database of sanctions, watchlists, PEPs and adverse media, with both synchronous and asynchronous modes plus batch processing. Screening results surface as hits. Multiple screening configurations can be created and one chosen per customer, which implies list selection. missing for 10: explicit documentation that specific sanctions/watchlists can be selected per configuration, explicit coverage of individuals vs companies as distinct entity types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
